passages.S03.title: S03 · Igbo traditional wedding (igba nkwu), mother of the bride
passages.S03.context: She is 54, from Anambra, mother of the bride. She is not a titled woman. The ceremony is outdoors in a family compound, in the afternoon.
passages.S03-D: A thin printed wrapper that imitates George, a plain cotton blouse, plastic coral beads, an ichafu in a clashing colour.

/brief/titledWoman.quote: She is not a titled woman
